posts.title: When was SOS introduced as the international distress signal?
posts.description: SOS became the international distress signal under the 1906 Berlin International Radiotelegraph Convention, in force from 1 July 1908.

posts.title: How to use a rotary/dial phone
posts.description: A 1927 AT&T silent film taught people to use the new rotary/dial phone.

posts.title: Why do ICAO airport codes have weird prefixes?
posts.description: Why Boston is KBOS and not BOS: ICAO airport codes start with a routing area letter, and the US got K from 1912 call signs.
